title: metais.grep/1
description: What metais grep prints with --json: the matching lines of the entries searched, each with its context (ADR-008 D5, grep). No match is an empty result, not a refusal.

globs.description: The globs, as given; [] when every entry but those beneath a dot segment was searched.

matches.description: The matching lines reported, at most --max-results, in entry path order and line order.

matching_lines.description: Every matching line found, reported or not; a line with several matches counts once.

truncated.description: Whether matching lines were found beyond those reported.

skipped.description: The binary entries among those searched, in path order.

text.description: The line without its line ending, cut at the last UTF-8 boundary within 1024 bytes when it is longer.

text_truncated.description: Whether text was cut; read --lines gives the whole line.

before.description: The lines of context before, in order.

after.description: The lines of context after, in order.

text.description: The line without its line ending, cut at the last UTF-8 boundary within 1024 bytes when it is longer.

text_truncated.description: Whether text was cut; read --lines gives the whole line.
